entry.title: fix(volcengine): correct the reasoning_effort levels and drop redunda…
entry.content:
fix(volcengine): correct the reasoning_effort levels and drop redundant toggles (#5564)

Ark accepts none|minimal|low|medium|high|xhigh|max; these entries only
declared four, so max was never reachable. Invalid values like 'banana'
return InvalidParameter, so this is a real accept-set rather than a field
that swallows anything.

Per AGENTS.md an effort list containing 'none' must not be paired with a
toggle, and measurement agrees: sending an effort alone already enables
thinking (reasoning_tokens > 0 with no thinking.type sent), enabled+none
yields 0, and disabled + a graded effort is rejected outright. The two
controls conflict rather than compose.

doubao-seed-character-260628 keeps its toggle: it defaults thinking off
and rejects a bare effort, so thinking.type is the real switch there. Its
effort list omits 'none' accordingly.

Change-Id: I86485c5fd3ed1697fc620f54398d634f3453b188

Co-authored-by: chenyunpeng.1024 <chenyunpeng.1024@bytedance.com>

entry.title: fix: author Alibaba context pricing tiers (#5597)
entry.content:
fix: author Alibaba context pricing tiers (#5597)

* fix: author Qwen3.5 context pricing tiers

Alibaba Cloud Model Studio prices the Qwen3.5 models on a context tier
keyed to input tokens per request, and every token in a request bills at
its tier's unit price. Three catalog entries published a single flat
rate for models that have two bands.

- alibaba-cn qwen3.5-397b-a17b published 0.430/2.58, which is the
  128K<Token<=256K band, as the model's only price. Requests at or below
  128K actually bill 0.172/1.032, so the entry overstated the common
  case by 2.5x. Corrected the base to the lower band and authored the
  upper band as a tier.
- merge-gateway qwen3.5-397b-a17b and qwen3.5-35b-a3b published only the
  lower band. The Gateway API's pricing object carries one input/output
  pair per vendor route and exposes no tier, so the sync cannot derive
  the second band; cost.tiers is preserved from disk across resyncs.

Thinking-mode and non-thinking-mode output are priced identically in
both bands, so alibaba-cn's cost.reasoning tiers alongside cost.output.
No cache-read price is published for the upper band, so the tiers do not
restate one.

Source: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/model-studio/model-pricing
(accessed 2026-08-26)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

* revert: drop merge-gateway Qwen3.5 tiers

The merge-gateway entries for qwen3.5-397b-a17b and qwen3.5-35b-a3b are
not priced off Alibaba Cloud's own route, so Alibaba's context tier
schedule does not apply to them.

Both files carry limit.context = 256_000 and limit.output = 64_000. On
the Gateway's live catalog those are EmpirioLabs' figures; the Alibaba
Cloud route reports a 131K context and a 33K max output. The cache_read
values match the Alibaba Cloud route only because
mergeGatewayCachePricing falls back to existing?.cost?.cache_read when
the selected route exposes none, so they are preserved curated values
rather than evidence of which route was selected.

That leaves the selected route as a reseller mirroring Alibaba's lower
band at a wider context window, with no published tier of its own.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix: author remaining Alibaba context pricing tiers

Sweeping the vendor pricing page for every model whose published rate is
banded turns up six more catalog entries that publish a single flat
price. Same defect as qwen3.5-397b-a17b, same source.

Correct low band, upper bands simply missing:

- alibaba-cn qwen3-coder-480b-a35b-instruct  32K -> 1.291/5.161, 128K -> 2.151/8.602
- alibaba-cn qwen3-coder-30b-a3b-instruct    32K -> 0.323/1.291, 128K -> 0.538/2.151
- alibaba    qwen3-coder-480b-a35b-instruct  32K -> 2.7/13.5,    128K -> 4.5/22.5
- alibaba    qwen3-coder-30b-a3b-instruct    32K -> 0.75/3.75,   128K -> 1.2/6

Wrong band published as the flat rate:

- alibaba-cn glm-5 published 0.86/3.15, which is the 32K<Token<=166K
  band. The entry rate is 0.573/2.58.
- alibaba-cn glm-5.1 published 0.87/3.48, which matches neither band.
  Both bands are taken from the vendor page: 0.825/3.301 up to 32K and
  1.100/3.851 above it. The page publishes no cache-read price for
  either band, so the existing curated cache_read is left on the base
  and not restated on the tier.

glm-4.6 and glm-4.7 are banded on the same page but have no alibaba-cn
entry. glm-5.2 is flat-rate and already correct.

Source: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/model-studio/model-pricing
(accessed 2026-08-26)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
